art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Miss Fortune is an adult pirate captain with very long vivid red hair, green eyes, a broad tricorn-style hat, and a confident composed face. Preserve the sea-captain silhouette using a fully closed long-sleeved coat over an opaque shirt, covered legs, gloves, and boots. Her paired ornate pistols remain securely inside closed side holsters, with no revealing neckline, sexualized pose, aiming, or smoke.
art_direction.scene: A broad full-body study, weight settled naturally on the feet or canonical support, expansive silhouette and an economical pale environment cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: scarlet hair, midnight navy, brass, amber sea light; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
